thread:
Marco: Heads-up: Atlas Summit microtrack planning. We need owners for speaker confirmations, live demo staging, recorded fallback, and shipping the partner sample kits. Can we divide tasks?

Amaya: I got speakers. Reached out to Alice + Rohan. Waiting on final titles and any special AV.

Devin: I can run demo staging. Request: partner test creds and a sandbox endpoint (read-only). Also will prepare a 2-min fallback video.

Sarah-Partner: I will send creds tomorrow AM via secure link. Note our service runs on v1.2-quant (int8)  some latency variance vs cloud prod. Will include endpoint + rate limits.

Clare: Ill handle kits. We have 120 sample kits assembled. Need final name/address list by Thu EOD. Spreadsheet schema: 

```
Full name | Company | Shipping address | Dietary notes
```

Marco: Also want a short recorded fallback demo for booth loop if live hits issues. Devin, can you record Wed and edit Thu morning?

Devin: Yep. Plan: record Wed evening, quick edit Thu AM, upload to Drive. Ill also bring a backup laptop with the recording and a USB stick.

Amaya: For speakers: decks by Thu noon and 5-min dry run Fri. I can coordinate dry-run timeslotswho can block 30m for scheduling?

Sarah-Partner: We can do tech dry run Fri 9am PST. Also uploading a small demo dataset for validation.

Clare: Shipping note: international kits need HS code 9504.50 for promotional items. If partners include branded hardware, flag asap for customs docs.

Marco: AV Q: demo rig needs HDMI + USB-C + 1x ethernet. Is that sufficient?

Devin: Yes. Ill bring an HDMI cable, ethernet, and a USB-C adapter. Also a spare battery + power strip.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create ticket PRTSHP-1323 "Atlas microtrack - kits + demo fallback" and attach shipping manifest by Thu.

Marco: Owners: Amaya = speakers/dry-run; Devin = demo staging + recording; Clare = kit shipping; Sarah-Partner = creds + dataset. Ill own run-of-show/MC notes. Update the sheet when you complete items. :thumbsup:

Amaya: Done  added speaker slots and scheduled dry-run windows.

Devin: Placeholder recording uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/atlas/microtrack/fallback-placeholder (will replace after editing).

Clare: Draft shipping manifest in ops folder. Waiting on addresses to confirm courier and customs.

Sarah-Partner: Sent secure creds link and uploaded validation dataset.

Marco: Great. Well reconvene after dry runs. If anything pops up, DM or post in #oncall-events. Thanks! :party_parrot:
